items.lede: Anthropic has committed $3.4 billion to secure 1.7GW of gas-fired generators from OnePWR Solutions, taking over existing Caterpillar orders as lengthy equipment lead times push AI companies to build their own power infrastructure
items.title: Anthropic skips six-year waitlist with massive $3.4 billion gas turbine generator deal

items.title: Anthropic joins AI’s natural gas frenzy, buys $3.4B worth of turbines
